## Partial result and unresolved original target

Add the proof-only reconstructed turn-3 partial for 2907 / KP 4.31. The original problem remains **UNSOLVED, 3/5**; this edition adds no substantive proof-search turn and changes no queue row.

## Accepted mathematical scope

In the specific standard-ball pair modeled from Zhang's surface cork, every nonzero power of the longitudinal boundary twist has no continuous extension to the open complement of the two annuli. The resulting annular images are pairwise inequivalent by a homeomorphism fixing the entire boundary sphere pointwise. Their abstract complement groups are all F2 and their first homology groups are all Z². The witness is the marked boundary-inclusion kernel, not varying abstract groups or homology.

A fixed connected oriented cobordism to an arbitrary prescribed smooth oriented knot gives connected smooth surfaces of common genus h+2 with exactly that knot as boundary. Neither outer-boundary-relative topological equivalence of those grafts nor survival of smooth inequivalence under grafting is proved.

**Mandatory distinction:** fixation of the surface cobordism alone does not imply fixation of the full internal sphere. The obstruction applies to an ambient comparison restricting to a pair map of the original ball fixed on its entire boundary, for example one fixed on the whole ambient product shell. No internal seam marking may be added to the original problem. This correction is visibly applied in REPORT.md and retained in PRECISION_OVERLAY.md.

## Audit and editorial treatment

The fresh independent AI mathematical/source audit is retained in full mathematical detail. It accepted the reconstructed input subject to the mandatory full-inner-sphere clarification, which is visibly applied in the report and retained in the overlay. The original audited input and later editorial bytes are separately identified; no historical byte-identical recovery or transfer of an old missing-file acceptance is claimed.

- REPORT.md updates pending-review language; applies the required full-inner-sphere correction visibly in Section 7, item 3; incorporates the already-audited single-extension/common-collar strengthening in Section 5; and replaces local recovery-file references with current edition records.
- AUDIT.md retains the complete reasoning and all qualifications. Only an edition note and replacement of one local-storage pathname are editorial changes.
- PRECISION_OVERLAY.md is preserved byte-for-byte, including the precise reconstructed input to which it originally applied. Its required and optional changes are now incorporated in REPORT.md.
- SOURCE_MANIFEST.json retains public bibliographic, retrieval and inspection metadata plus raw public PDF identities. Storage paths and derived extracted-text fingerprints are omitted. SOURCE_INSPECTION.json selects the actual source-inspection history from the independent audit, without its local inventories.

These are authored proof/audit documents and public bibliography/retrieval/inspection metadata only. The primary source foundations remain credited in the complete report. No novelty, conventional human peer review, formal proof-assistant certification or literature-wide current-open-status claim is made. Historical source inspections are not presented as newly repeated at publication.

## Exact scope and integrity

Exactly ten additive files under `unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/2907/`. No existing file, queue, unrelated content, executable program, fixture, standalone computation result/log, copied third-party source document/text/image, dataset content, private source or private coordination material is included. The noncircular manifest hashes the other nine members. Local clean additive patch replay establishes exact byte reproduction, not mathematical truth.
